title: Print-room color check
passage:
Production note | Requesting a color correction

Photo proofs taken beside the east loading door looked warmer than the approved sample. The paper prints from the same batch, however, matched the sample in the inspection booth. The booth uses a fixed white light. Near the loading door, afternoon light can warm the appearance of both paper and photographs.

For a color complaint, first put a current print and the approved sample side by side in the booth. Record whether the visible difference is still present. A photo may help show where the complaint started, but it cannot replace this comparison.

If the difference disappears in the booth, leave the press settings alone and note where the first check was made. If the difference remains, turn both sheets a quarter turn without changing their positions. A patch that moves with the sheet is on the print. A patch that stays in the same spot is probably caused by the booth lighting. Only ask the press operator to investigate after the difference has been traced to a print.
passageZh:
生產紀錄｜如何提出色差修正

在東側裝卸門旁拍的校樣照片，看起來比核准樣品偏暖。但同批紙本印刷品在檢驗室內看起來與樣品一致。檢驗室使用固定的白光。午後的光線可能讓裝卸門附近的紙張與照片都看起來偏暖。

接到色差反映時，先將本批印刷品與核准樣品並排放在檢驗室，記下肉眼是否仍看得出差異。照片可用來說明問題最初在哪裡被發現，但不能代替這項比對。

如果差異在檢驗室內消失，維持印刷機原設定，並記下最初檢查的位置。如果差異仍在，把兩張紙各轉四分之一圈，但不要移動紙張所在的位置。色斑如果跟著紙張移動，就在印刷品上；若留在原處，較可能是檢驗室照明所致。只有確定差異來自印刷品，才請印刷機操作員調查。
